boards.title: Your First Weekend at Hope College, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A practical first-weekend sequence built from Hope College’s current 2026 Orientation schedule and official campus destination pages. Confirm the final Orientation schedule upon arrival because published plans may change.

cards.entity_name: Jim and Martie Bultman Student Center
cards.title: Start at Orientation Headquarters
cards.subtitle: Stop 1 · Get situated at the center of campus
cards.notes: Pick up your welcome materials, identify the help desk, and use this central stop to resolve questions before the weekend gets busy.
cards.short_summary: Establish a reliable campus home base before moving through the weekend schedule.
cards.evidence_claim: Hope College identifies the Bultman Student Center as New Student Orientation headquarters and says Orientation team members are available there to help.
cards.access_notes: Orientation welcome packets for students not living in a residence hall may be collected here; follow the emailed check-in instructions.

cards.title: Learn the Phelps Routine
cards.subtitle: Stop 2 · Practice the main dining-hall flow
cards.notes: Enter through the north doors on 10th Street, scan the serving areas, and note where you will return for weekend meals.
cards.short_summary: Use an early meal to make the primary campus dining location feel familiar.
cards.evidence_claim: Hope Dining says meal-plan swipes are accepted at Phelps Dining and directs diners to use its north entrance on 10th Street.
cards.access_notes: Dining requires an eligible meal-plan swipe, Dining Dollars where accepted, or payment at the posted retail rate.

cards.title: Find the Chapel Landmark
cards.subtitle: Stop 3 · Anchor your mental map
cards.notes: Approach from College Avenue, locate the tower and rose window, and use the building as a visual reference point for later walks.
cards.short_summary: A prominent historic landmark provides an easy orientation point on campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Hope describes Dimnent Memorial Chapel as its campus’s most prominent landmark and documents its Gothic structure, rose window and stained glass.
cards.access_notes: The page documents the building but does not promise unrestricted public entry; enter only for a scheduled or authorized program.

cards.title: Locate Campus Ministries
cards.subtitle: Stop 4 · Identify a student-support destination
cards.notes: Join the scheduled open house if it fits your program, then save the building name and location for future ministry questions.
cards.short_summary: Put a face and physical location to one of Hope’s campus-support communities.
cards.evidence_claim: Hope’s current Orientation student schedule places the Campus Ministries Open House at van Andel Huys der Hope.
cards.access_notes: Attend during the scheduled Orientation open house or during subsequently posted Campus Ministries access times.

cards.title: Try the Pine Grove Social Hour
cards.subtitle: Stop 5 · Choose a low-pressure outdoor activity
cards.notes: Walk the central green, join the scheduled yard games if interested, and identify a shaded meeting point for your group.
cards.short_summary: Use an outdoor Orientation option to learn a central gathering landscape at your own pace.
cards.evidence_claim: Hope’s current Orientation schedule lists Saturday yard games at Pine Grove and Sunday’s Involvement Fair there.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor programming is schedule- and weather-dependent; consult the final schedule supplied upon arrival.

cards.title: Choose the Indoor Movie Option
cards.subtitle: Stop 6 · Keep a weather-proof evening plan
cards.notes: Find Schaap Auditorium inside Bultman before the program begins, then use the film as an easy shared activity with new classmates.
cards.short_summary: An indoor movie offers a structured evening option without requiring specialized gear or experience.
cards.evidence_claim: Hope’s current Orientation schedule lists a Saturday evening movie in Bultman Student Center’s Schaap Auditorium.
cards.access_notes: This is an Orientation program; verify the final film, time and room assignment in the arrival schedule.

cards.title: Map Your Recreation Base
cards.subtitle: Stop 7 · Find student fitness facilities
cards.notes: Locate the gym, indoor track, conditioning area and pool access points, then check current facility rules before returning to exercise.
cards.short_summary: A brief walkthrough makes Hope’s main activity-oriented facility easier to use later.
cards.evidence_claim: Hope says the Dow Center contains a gymnasium, conditioning area, indoor track, racquetball courts and swimming pool, with free access for Hope students.
cards.access_notes: Hope students have free facility access; verify current hours, registration requirements and area-specific rules before exercising.

cards.title: Walk Toward Downtown Holland
cards.subtitle: Stop 8 · Learn the campus-to-downtown connection
cards.notes: Start with the official Orientation group when offered, note the route from Bultman, and keep the outing focused on public storefront streets.
cards.short_summary: A guided first walk builds confidence moving between campus and downtown.
cards.evidence_claim: Hope’s current Orientation schedule includes a transfer-student downtown exploration that meets at the Bultman Student Center Orientation Station.
cards.access_notes: The listed outing is designated for transfer students; other students should use only programming assigned to them or explore public areas independently.

cards.entity_name: Jack H. Miller Center for Musical Arts
cards.title: Arrive Early for Convocation
cards.subtitle: Stop 9 · Preview an academic gathering venue
cards.notes: Find the Columbia Avenue entrance before the crowd arrives, take your assigned seat, and note the building for future performances.
cards.short_summary: Opening Convocation introduces an important performance and assembly destination.
cards.evidence_claim: Hope’s current Orientation schedule places Sunday’s Opening Convocation at Jack Miller, and Hope identifies the center at 221 Columbia Avenue.
cards.access_notes: Attend Convocation according to the final Orientation schedule and any seating or arrival instructions supplied by Hope.

cards.title: Finish with the Involvement Fair
cards.subtitle: Stop 10 · Turn introductions into next steps
cards.notes: Choose a few tables tied to genuine interests, ask how newcomers participate, and save one concrete follow-up for the first week.
cards.short_summary: Close the weekend by identifying specific communities to revisit after classes begin.
cards.evidence_claim: Hope’s current Orientation schedule lists the Involvement Fair in Pine Grove on Sunday after Opening Convocation.
cards.access_notes: The event time and outdoor location are subject to change; use the final schedule provided upon arrival.

warnings: Hope states that the Orientation schedule is subject to change and that a final schedule will be supplied upon arrival.
The published $130 Orientation fee covers Orientation events; cards tied to that program are marked purchase_required rather than free.
Coordinates and maps URLs are null because they were not independently verified from direct public map records during this pass.
